title: Why Neural Networks Overfit: Causes, Detection, and Mitigation
narrative_thread: overfitting is a capacity/data mismatch, not a mysterious failure — every mitigation follows from that one idea

sections.title: What Overfitting Actually Is
sections.goal: define the phenomenon precisely and distinguish it from underfitting
key_questions: how is overfitting formally detected, not just intuited

sections.title: Root Causes
sections.goal: explain the mechanisms that produce overfitting
sections.bridge_from_previous: having defined overfitting by its symptom, the natural next question is what produces it
key_questions: which cause dominates in practice for modern deep nets

sections.title: Mitigation Techniques
sections.goal: survey the standard toolbox and when each applies
sections.bridge_from_previous: each cause above maps to a specific class of fix
key_questions: how do these compose in a real training pipeline
